blocks.text: Tree data structure information (maloomat) ko ek main point se phailte hue organize karta hai; is point ko root node (jarr) kehte hain. Tree mein information ke har tukre ko node kehte hain, aur ek node doosre nodes se jur sakta hai. Is tarah branches (shaakhon) wali shakal banti hai. Yeh list se alag hai, jis mein items ek seedhi line mein ek ke baad ek hote hain.

Misal: family tree (khandan ka shajra) mein sab se purane buzurg root node hote hain; yahin se hierarchy (oopar se neeche darjon wali tarteeb) shuru hoti hai. Har shakhs ki aulad agle level banati hai. Kitab ki Figure 4.5 mein oopar dada-dadi, un ke neeche ammi-abbu aur chacha-chachi, aur sab se neeche bachche aur cousins dikhaye gaye hain. Parent aur child (maa-baap aur aulad) ke aise rishte seedhi list mein achhi tarah nahi rakhe ja sakte, is liye tree istemal hota hai, jis se information saaf dikhti aur aasani se milti hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein Figure 4.5 ke baad yeh jumla chhapa hai: “Certainly! Here's a simplified version ...”. Yeh editing mein reh jane wala faltu jumla hai (kisi writing assistant ka jawab); sabaq ka hissa nahi.

blocks.title: Did You Know?
blocks.text: Kitab ke mutabiq tree data structure ka idea sab se pehle computer scientist John McCarthy ne 1960 mein diya.

blocks.prompt: Family tree ko list ki bajaye tree mein rakhna kyun behtar hai?
blocks.explanation: List sirf ek seedha order rakhti hai, jabke tree yeh bhi rakhta hai ke kaun kis ka parent hai, yaani branches wali hierarchy.

items: Tree: root se phailte nodes; family tree jaisi hierarchy ke liye theek.
